svg.title: I started with maps. A geography degree, then a first job teaching maths to teenagers in China. Then the industry vanished. Almost overnight, private tutoring was regulated out of existence. At thirty, I began again. I moved to New Zealand and read for a Master of Applied Computing. I learned to build with AI. From my first assignment I paired with a model. Today I direct coding agents. I am a minimalist. Everything I own fits in one backpack and one suitcase. I subtract until only the idea is left. The work spoke first. A founder asked Claude Code to find an AI architect. It surfaced me. I hadn't applied; the work had. Now I build AI agents. Founder of ArchCanvas. CTO at FemTech Weekend. Based in Auckland.
